sources.use: Target revision/scope header, all 33 exact applicability selectors, and F1 gap authority.
Canonical arrival/topology selectors; water not applicable at dry-pine-ridge water_body; no natural visual source creates stock; canonical entry does not inherit generated finite stocks.
Candidate firesteel type, mechanics/property descriptions and candidate mass; not target stock or adopted mass.
Candidate flint type; not target stock.
Candidate tinder type; not target stock.
Candidate kindling bundle type; its 500 g is not adopted.
Bounded evidence for XII-century Novgorod firesteel; explicit note says it does not establish fuel, lamp or guaranteed ignition.
Approved domain-internal use claim for striking fire, regional and temporal bound 1100-1300; no presence/ownership.
Draft item type seeds only: firesteel, striking flint, tinder, kindling.
Birch bark material candidate; uses include tinder process, not target harvestable stock.
Deadwood, brushwood, driftwood candidates and game-unit masses/stock rules; not F1 placement/access binding.
Qualitative combustion dependencies; no fixed rate, fuel ratio or guaranteed fire.
Limits of charcoal/fuel process evidence; no scene stock or exact yield/duration.
Qualitative water cooling can assist on ordinary solid fuel/flame; no quantity or success rule.
Shape reference only; its refs, quantities, masses and policy are excluded from v17.
Candidate property/quantity schema example; low-confidence household placement/500g excluded from target values.
Owner decisions: free materialization, fire basic action, D38-D40 by existence with logical_necessity, properties over lists, D59 outside-world-stock rule.
Exact four finite-source design definitions and the five G4/family joins used by the F1 scopes; authoring design data only.

Per-G4 property-context candidate and free-gathering/parcel-right policy. Completeness assertion applies only to new generated G5 and explicitly excludes canonical G5 (105-115); pointer on canonical F1 scope is informational G4 context, not current property decision/readback.
Exact candidate SHA pins and APPROVE_DATA_ONLY scope/exclusions for finite-source and property-context candidates.
No semantic fallback that masks absent required authoritative data; applies to data substitution, not rejecting a player attempt.
D-014 separates authored candidate-set hard gaps from ordinary direct action result; typed gap is not physical impossibility, world absence or refusal.
Player requests, including ordinary/physically impossible/missing-item attempts, are mapped to a real attempt; action/cause/physics owners resolve the outcome.
Existing owner vocabulary start/add_fuel/affect/due_boundary; source for conceptual decomposition only, not target profile authority.
